name: Hierarchical DDA with Super-brick Skipping
aliases: Exact shadow trace with super-brick skipping and occupied-box early-out
definition: A shadow tracing algorithm that uses a two-level occupancy hierarchy (super-bricks and bricks) to skip empty regions and an axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) to terminate rays early, maintaining pixel-identical output to the fine per-voxel DDA.
summary: Hierarchical DDA with Super-brick Skipping accelerates ray tracing by using a two-level hierarchy to skip empty regions while maintaining pixel-identical output.
